title: Shakshuka
headnote: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce. One skillet, breakfast or dinner.
steps: Warm the oil in a large deep skillet over medium heat. Cook the onion and pepper until soft, about 8 minutes.
Stir in the garlic, cumin and paprika for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and salt, crushing the tomatoes with a spoon. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Make six wells in the sauce, crack in the eggs, cover and cook 6 to 8 minutes, until the whites are set.
Top with the feta and parsley and serve with the bread.

title: Garlic Butter Shrimp with Rice
headnote: Shrimp in a lemony garlic butter, ready in about twenty minutes.
ingredients: 1½ lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined
steps: Cook the rice according to the package directions.
Melt 2 tablespoons of the butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the shrimp 2 minutes per side, then transfer to a plate.
Melt the remaining butter, cook the garlic and pepper flakes for 30 seconds, then add the lemon juice.
Return the shrimp to the pan, toss with the parsley and salt, and serve over the rice.

title: Turkey Chili
headnote: A big pot of mild, hearty chili that feeds a crowd and freezes well.
ingredients: 2 (15-oz) cans kidney beans, drained and rinsed
steps: Warm the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Cook the onion and pepper until soft, about 8 minutes, then add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the turkey and cook, breaking it up, until no longer pink, about 8 minutes.
Stir in the chili powder and cumin, then the tomatoes, beans, broth and salt.
Simmer for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Season to taste.

title: Chickpea Coconut Curry
headnote: Chickpeas and spinach simmered in a spiced coconut sauce. Fully plant-based and ready in forty minutes.
steps: Cook the rice according to the package directions.
Melt the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Cook the onion until soft, about 6 minutes, then stir in the garlic, ginger and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the chickpeas, coconut milk, tomatoes and salt. Simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted and serve over the rice.

title: Sheet-Pan Chicken Fajitas
headnote: Chicken, peppers and onions roasted with a chili-cumin rub, served in warm tortillas.
ingredients: 1½ lb boneless skinless chicken breasts, sliced
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss the chicken, peppers and onion with the oil, chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, salt and half the lime juice on a large sheet pan.
Roast for 20 minutes, stirring once, until the chicken is cooked through.
Warm the tortillas and serve the fajita mix with the cilantro and the remaining lime juice.

title: Garlic Spinach Pasta
headnote: Penne tossed with garlicky wilted spinach, lemon and Parmesan. Fifteen minutes of actual cooking.
steps: Cook the penne in salted boiling water until al dente. Reserve ½ cup of the pasta water, then drain.
Warm the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the garlic and pepper flakes until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the spinach and cook until wilted, about 2 minutes.
Toss in the pasta, lemon juice, Parmesan and salt, loosening with pasta water as needed.

title: Turkey Stuffed Peppers
headnote: Bell peppers filled with seasoned turkey and rice, baked until tender with melted mozzarella on top.
steps: Cook the rice according to the package directions.
Heat the oven to 375°F. Cut the tops off the peppers, remove the seeds and stand the peppers in a baking dish.
Warm the oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cook the onion for 5 minutes, then add the garlic and turkey and cook until browned, about 8 minutes.
Stir in the rice, half the tomato sauce, the Italian seasoning and the salt. Spoon into the peppers.
Pour the remaining sauce over the top, cover with foil and bake for 30 minutes. Uncover, sprinkle with the mozzarella and bake 10 minutes more.

title: Sesame Peanut Noodles
headnote: Cold noodles in a savory peanut-sesame sauce with crisp cucumber. Good warm too, and they keep well for lunch.
steps: Cook the noodles according to the package directions. Drain and rinse under cold water.
Whisk the soy sauce, peanut butter, sesame oil, rice vinegar, maple syrup, garlic and ginger into a sauce.
Toss the noodles with the sauce, cucumber and scallions.
Serve topped with the sesame seeds.

title: Smoky Black Bean Soup
headnote: A thick, smoky soup from pantry staples. Blend half for a creamier texture.
ingredients: 3 (15-oz) cans black beans, drained and rinsed
steps: Warm the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Cook the onion and pepper until soft, about 8 minutes, then add the garlic, cumin and paprika for 1 minute.
Add the beans, broth and salt. Simmer for 20 minutes.
Blend about half the soup with an immersion blender for a thicker texture.
Stir in the lime juice and serve topped with the cilantro.

title: Lemon Herb Chicken with Green Beans
headnote: Pan-seared chicken breasts with a quick lemon-parsley pan sauce, served with buttery green beans.
steps: Pat the chicken dry and season with half the salt and the pepper.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the chicken 5 minutes per side, until cooked through, and transfer to a plate.
Melt 1 tablespoon of the butter in the skillet, cook the garlic for 30 seconds, then add the broth and lemon juice and simmer 3 minutes. Swirl in the parsley.
Steam the green beans for 5 minutes, then toss with the remaining butter and salt. Serve with the chicken and pan sauce.
